title: skills-sh-chromedevtools-chrome-devtools-mcp-chrome-devtools
summary: # Troubleshooting ## General tips - Run `npx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --help` to test if the MCP server runs on your machine. - Make sure that your MCP client uses the same npm and node version as your terminal. - When configuring your MCP client, try using the `--yes` argument to `npx` to auto-accept installation prompt. - Find a specific error in the output of the `chrome-devtools-mcp` server. Usually, if your client is an IDE, logs would be in the Output pane. - Search the [GitHub repository issues and discussions](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp) for help or existing similar problems. ## Debugging
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/main/docs/troubleshooting.md
